aerial.title: Aerial – results
aerial.hint: Score = average of all runs (unless the category says otherwise). Empty fields do not count.

de.title: Double elimination – results
de.hint: Bracket score = (n − DE rank + 1) / n, n = teams in the bracket (calculated from the rank). The DE score of the overall ranking comes from the formula (bracket weighting).

doc.title: Documentation & paper – scoring
doc.hint: Documentation score = 0.2·part 1 + 0.2·part 2 + 0.2·part 3 + 0.4·onsite (missing parts count 0). “Formula value” is the value the overall ranking uses with the season's formula set.
doc.formulaValueHint: Value from the season's formula set

layout.title: OCR layout
layout.hint: Set where the OCR reads each confirmed field on the sheet: pick a field and drag a rectangle on the page, or enter the values as a percentage of the page. A reference image (scan or photo of a blank sheet) helps with drawing; it stays in the browser and is not uploaded.
layout.noFields: Confirm the fields first, then set the OCR layout.
layout.saved: OCR layout saved. New scans use it; failed scans can be processed again in the OCR review.
layout.saveFailed: The layout could not be saved.

anchors.title: Anchors
anchors.hint: Anchors are printed reference marks (filled squares) on the sheet. With two or more, the OCR aligns every scan by them; four in the corners also straighten sheets photographed at an angle. Without anchors, or when they are missing on a scan, the sheet edge is used. To draw, choose “Anchors” above and drag a rectangle around each mark.
anchors.name: Name
anchors.surface: Page – drag a rectangle around a reference mark
anchors.tooFew: At least {{min}} anchors are needed, otherwise the OCR aligns by the sheet edge.

rules.title: Validation rules
rules.hint: The rules decide which read values are flagged in the OCR review. Every scan is still reviewed and accepted by hand.
rules.fieldHint: Empty cells add no check. The limits from the schema always apply; the stricter one wins.
rules.noSums: No sum rules. Example: all cubes together can be at most 12.
